summary: Progress Software filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, reporting completion of its purchase of substantially all assets and employees of Domo, Inc., excluding Domo's net operating loss carryforwards, under an Asset Purchase Agreement dated July 22, 2026. Progress paid $400 million in cash, funded via cash on hand and an existing revolving credit facility. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Progress will file audited financial statements and pro forma information by amendment under Regulation S-X. Watch integration execution, leverage impact, and purchase-price allocation, with no public deal spread remaining.
